messages.content: "你能幫我幾件事嗎？首先，我想要計算一個底為12公尺、高為15公尺的三角形的面積。我希望結果以平方公尺為單位。其次，我對「電話」的發明者和發明年份很感興趣。你能幫我找到嗎？最後，我正在計劃一次公路旅行，需要從「紐約市」到「洛杉磯」的路線指引。我希望避開「收費站」和「高速公路」。你能為我提供最佳路線嗎？"

So we need to retrieve inventor and year. We can use get_invention with want_year=true maybe also want inventor automatically returned? Let's check tool signature: type science_history_get_invention = ({ invention_name:string,want_year:boolean }) -> any. It returns presumably inventor and optionally year. But no mention about returning inventor separately. Might return object containing inventor and year. We'll call it once with want_year:true.

But do we need separate calls for inventor only or just one call retrieving both? Probably one call will give both fields. Use want_year:true.

We might need two calls: first get inventor, second get year. But better to request both at once. Since tool doesn't specify how many outputs but likely includes both. We'll ask for both.

3) Get directions from New York City to Los Angeles avoiding tolls and highways. Provide best route. Use map_service_get_directions start="New York City", end="Los Angeles", avoid=["tolls","highways"].

Thus produce JSON array of calls: first geometry_area_triangle, then science_history_get_invention, then map_service_get_directions.

For geometry_area_triangle: {base:12,height:15}. Unit defaults to sqm so optional omitted.

For map_service_get_directions: {start:"New York City", end:"Los Angeles", avoid:["toll","highway"]?? Wait avoid expects union of strings "tolls"|"highways"|["ferries"]. In example earlier, avoid could be ["tolls","highways"], but the schema says avoid?: "tolls" | "highways" | "ferries"[], meaning either single string or list of ferries? That seems odd. Possibly it's mis-specified. Example usage shows avoid:["tolls","highways"]. So we'll pass array of strings. For safety include all needed: ["tolls","highways"]
